newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish bourse's new 97 issues seen worth PLN 6 bln.
newsitem.headline: Polish bourse's new 97 issues seen worth PLN 6 bln.

text.p: This year's new issues on the Warsaw bourse are likely to be worth about six billion zlotys, or 20 percent of the market's current capitalisation, IB Austria brokerage said on Monday.

"According to our forecast, the value of offerings which could enter the stock exchange this year will amount to six billion zlotys," IB Austria's sales director Mieczyslaw Lazor told a news conference.
The bourse's capitalisation was 31.7 billion zlotys in mid-February.
IB Austria also forecasts that the number of listed firms will increase to more than 140 in 1997 from the current 88.
